fusions.name: Smeared Edge
fusions.desc: Flicks a toxin-smeared blade at a target up to 7 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Cut From Below
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health: a cut from below that deals 18 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Out of Nowhere
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Close to Hand
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 10%.
